chapters.title: The founding
chapters.text:
The founding party arrived in summer. It included MaelColuim, Kauppi, Dervla, Áilu, Conán, Eaddis Olafsdóttir, Sigfrid Bjarnardóttir, Kauppi, Daugirdė and Inghild Sigurdardóttir.

The founding party had two adult cows and one adult bull and 1 longship.

MaelColuim and Inghild Sigurdardóttir were already partners. Kauppi and Dervla were already partners. Sigfrid Bjarnardóttir and Kauppi were already partners. Their first households lived in tents.

MaelColuim, Kauppi, Áilu and Kauppi worked as hunters. Dervla, Conán, Sigfrid Bjarnardóttir and Inghild Sigurdardóttir worked as fishers. Eaddis Olafsdóttir worked as a farmer. Daugirdė worked as a woodworker.
